assessment: This valuable manuscript explores the role of Uso1/p115, a protein that has been implicated in vesicle tethering at the ER-Golgi interface. By investigating a Uso1 mutant that allows Aspergillus cells to survive in the absence of Rab1, the authors conclude that the essential role of Uso1 is not actually tethering, but rather SNARE complex assembly mediated by the globular head domain. This convincing analysis significantly advances our understanding of Uso1 and also prompts a reevaluation of long-standing assumptions about coiled-coil proteins involved in vesicular transport.
